description:
Build a standard five-field cron expression from plain choices (every N minutes, hourly, daily, weekly, monthly, yearly) or explain an existing one. Returns the expression, an English description, the next run times in a time zone, and the same schedule for crontab, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions, Quartz and AWS EventBridge.

Returns: JSON { expression, description, nextRuns[], timezone, platforms[{ id, name, value, notes[] }], warnings[] }. value is null on Quartz/EventBridge when both day fields are restricted.
Example input: {"frequency":"weekly","daysOfWeek":["mon","wed","fri"],"hours":[9],"minute":30,"timezone":"America/New_York"}
On error, includes hint: Give either plain choices (frequency plus minute/hours/days) or a five-field expression. Days of week accept names or 0-6 with 0 = Sunday.

count.description: How many upcoming runs to list. Default 5.

daysOfMonth.description: For monthly or yearly: days of the month, e.g. [1, 15].

daysOfWeek.description: For weekly: days as names (mon, fri) or numbers 0-6 with 0 = Sunday.

expression.description: An existing five-field cron expression to explain and translate instead of building one.

frequency.description: How often to run. Ignored when expression is given. Default daily.

hours.description: Hours of the day in 24-hour time, e.g. [9] or [9, 17]. Default [0].

interval.description: For minutes: every N minutes (default 5). For hourly: every N hours (default 1).

timezone.description: IANA time zone for the next run times, e.g. Europe/London. Default UTC.

name: cron_build
title: Cron expression builder
